verses.text: A Psalm of thanksgiving. Make a joyful noise to the LORD, all the earth.

segments.text: A Psalm of thanksgiving. Make a joyful noise to the LORD, all the earth.

verses.text: Serve the LORD with gladness; come into His presence with joyful songs.

segments.text: Serve the LORD with gladness; come into His presence with joyful songs.

verses.text: Know that the LORD is God. It is He who made us, and we are His; we are His people, and the sheep of His pasture.

segments.text: Know that the LORD is God. It is He who made us, and we are His; we are His people, and the sheep of His pasture.

verses.text: Enter His gates with thanksgiving and His courts with praise; give thanks to Him and bless His name.

segments.text: Enter His gates with thanksgiving and His courts with praise; give thanks to Him and bless His name.

verses.text: For the LORD is good, and His loving devotion endures forever; His faithfulness continues to all generations.

segments.text: For the LORD is good, and His loving devotion endures forever; His faithfulness continues to all generations.
